Diagram scope retains AI/shared-Reel conversation only." vertex="1" parent="1" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;fontFamily=Arial;fontSize=14;fontColor=#253849;fontStyle=0;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacing=0;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;"><mxGeometry x="30" y="1480" width="1820" height="90" as="geometry"/></mxCell></root></mxGraphModel></diagram></mxfile>
